title: Suggest a Workshop Plan

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words about a fictional community workshop. Compare two display options, explain a concern and a solution, and give one arranged meeting before the event. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先说明目的和两个方案；比较一个优点及一个顾虑，提出可行的解决办法；最后说已安排的会面和下一步，不把未确认的预订写成已完成。

reference: Our neighborhood group has a proposal for a small art workshop. The event is planned for the Tuesday after the Friday meeting. The aim is to help people create a picture together without expecting a perfect artwork. One option is to place the work on a table, while the alternative is to use a board near the window. The board has the advantage of leaving a clear path, but we have a concern about where it can stand. Our solution is to ask the building manager before choosing the display. A designer has made a prototype with a pencil and a little glue, so we can test the size of the label. The organizer is meeting the manager on Friday to confirm the room. After that, I will prepare a leaflet and divide the remaining tasks among volunteers. We will ask before sharing a photograph that identifies someone. Each contribution can be small, and every participant can suggest an improvement.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
